(3) A soft 'Pop' SFX triggers as text highlights appear on the screen, synchronized with the speaker's emphasis on specific words. (4) A short 'Ding' sound occurs during the discussion of diplomatic irony, followed by another 'Whoosh' as a new news article is shown.
